subject: reasoning
question: In a certain coded language 'LAST' is coded as 'IXPQ' and 'PREZ' is coded as 'MOBW'. How will 'INTO' be coded in the same code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] The logic followed here is that each letter is shifted 3 positions backward (-3 pattern) in the alphabetical series. **For LAST : IXPQ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/031dc1e434212e971f7303c2175bac0a62be29647b62bc9d665d4a4fed26746d.png]
